title: コインパーキングのロック板
description: 時間貸し駐車場の車室中央に置く、車両固定用のロック板装置です。前後が傾斜した黒い低床ハウジング、上がった状態の黄色いフラップと黒い帯、蝶番の軸と支え、アンカーボルトを造形しています。フラップは約32度で固定され、上下動作、センサー、配線、精算機、区画線は含みません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.417 × 0.349 × 0.946 m、1,692三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A coin-parking flap lock placed in the middle of a pay-parking bay. It models the low black ramped housing, the yellow flap with black stripes in its raised position, hinge barrel and struts, and anchor bolts. The flap is fixed at about 32 degrees; raising and lowering motion, sensors, wiring, pay stations and bay markings are not included. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.417 × 0.349 × 0.946 m; 1,692 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or mounting pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Claude
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
